about: What viewer.html shows: per person the video attempts (cut-out VP9 alpha webm at the game file's size), the line under the portrait, the background capture and the notes table. Written by hand for this round.

line.name: Mio
line.html: Ugh, the Wi-Fi dies on the bridge every time... come on, come on.

rows.how: The approved neutral as the game shows it now, with the stage's CSS breathing (scaleY 1.006 over 4.2 s)

Wan 2.2 Fun VACE, skeleton driver (breath 4 px, head tilt 0.8 deg, blink at frame 34), the picture as first and last frame, 608x768, 81 frames at 16 fps, 6 steps, seed 1; baseline: Mio's neutral source render at game size (padded to 608x768), driver v1 (breath 4 px, head tilt 0.8 deg lagging, blink at frame 34), the picture as frame 0 and frame 80 (mask 0) and as reference, 81 frames at 16 fps, 6 steps (3 high + 3 low), shift 5, cfg 1, seed 1. Cut out frame by frame (ISNet + matte_refine).
rows.cost: 405 s on the 3080 (peak 9692 MB on the card), about 85 s of CPU for the cut-outs; straight loop 523 KB for 5 s, ping-pong 1008 KB for 9.9 s (VP9 with alpha); plays as one video per portrait
